status.description: Explicit state machine: created → active → closing → closed | closed_abnormally. An invalid transition responds 409.

kind.description: The INTENT with which the session was opened, chosen at creation and immutable. `consultiva` (consultative) is conversation only; `criativa` (creative) produces and is the only one that enters execution. Not to be confused with execution state, which remains the `execution.activated` event in the log.

name.description: Friendly name, or `null`. Screens compose it with the id's hashtag; it never replaces it.

nextSeq.description: Next `seq` of the event log. Serves as a cursor: `?afterSeq=41` fetches everything after 41.

terminationReason.description: Reason reported by the engine when terminating (heartbeat_timeout, killed, exception…). `null` on a human close or a still-live session.

traceParent.description: W3C `traceparent` of the root span. This is how the whole session is recovered in Tempo.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

404.description: Project or session does not exist.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
